verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs claim live dashboards showing compliance posture (sprinto-docs-22), management of multiple frameworks in one place (sprinto-docs-23), and continuous monitoring for audit readiness (sprinto-docs-25). A 'Framework Health' API page (sprinto-docs-17) suggests per-framework health tracking exists. None of this evidence describes a per-framework readiness view with passing controls, open gaps and remaining work as a single percentage. missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness percentage, explicit passing-control vs open-gap breakdown, detail on how the score is computed (the 'honest' element), independent or hands-on corroboration.
